I reviewed the change. It is not valid JSON on purpose: this fixture exists
to prove that a model which cannot follow the JSON schema still produces a
usable review through internal/prompt.ResponseParser's degraded fallback
(see docs/specs/AUR-430.md, "Parser fallback").

Findings:
- config/demo-tokens.txt:4: error: a plaintext credential was committed (DEMO_API_TOKEN)
- config/demo-tokens.txt:5: error: a plaintext credential was committed (DEMO_DB_PASSWORD)

That's everything worth flagging in this change.
